additional_info.subject: RE: ID0442911-DC/Si-D/GR-[MP / ND 170000202] Socket 1 Charging Issue CRM:02888000177
additional_info.body:
Dear Nikolaos Pantazelos,
I hope this message finds you well.
I wanted to inform you that charging was not started because charger outlet was temporarily unavailable due to a COAP error.
The COAP error you’ve encountered is due to a  interruption in internal communication between the SiC D and the SECC. Please rest assured that this is a temporary issue,charger outlets were temporarily unavailable.The issue has been resolved, Outlet is available now.
I trust that  your  query has been addressed, and you are satisfied with the provided answer.
The charger is now healthy, with no active error flags, and all outlets are available.
Could you kindly verify from your side and confirm that everything is functioning as expected?
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita
